text:
maria_sales: Heads-up: NetoBank asks for SOC2 excerpt + signed pen-test letter for the POC. Also wants dedicated pricing estimate if we need single-tenant staging. They need a minimal evidence pack by EOD Friday. Can ops/security confirm what we can share?

alex_se: Got it. Which controls do they need? Usually customers ask for CC1, CC3, network diagram, and pen test attestation. Any NDA/PSA signed?

maria_sales: They already signed NDA. Key ask: 'list of SOC 2 control narratives', 'external penetration test letter' and 'short architecture diagram showing tenant isolation'. Also want staging IPs and cost delta for dedicated vs shared POC.

sam_security: We can produce SOC2 excerpt + control mappings (redacted). Pen-test letter: we can provide our third-party attestation template but need legal sign-off for the signed letter. I'll start the draft. For architecture diagram, ops can export a simple ASCII diagram.

ellie_ops: I can do staging IPs and a compact network diagram. For dedicated POC pricing, we need expected tokens/hr and retention. ballpark: dedicated dev pool + reserved 2x A100 equiv = $X/mo; I'll calc if you share traffic profile.

maria_sales: I'll ask them for tokens/hr and sample prompt mix, and whether data residency matters.

alex_se: @sam_security do we have a sanitized SOC2 excerpt we can send now? Last time we used 'SOC2_excerpts_v2.pdf' in the drive.

sam_security: Yes, upload to shared drive and I'll redact PII. ETA 24h. For pen-test letter, legal needs the signer — cc @maria_sales pls confirm contact.

maria_sales: Contact is procurement@netobank.com — ok to cc legal?

audit_bot: Reminder: pen-test letter template requires the following fields: recipient, scope, date of test, signatory name. Use template: https://redwood.docs/pen-test-template

ellie_ops: For temporary staging creds we can offer presigned uploads and ephemeral kube access. If they need IP allowlist, provide CIDR block & schedule. Snippet for presigned URL script:

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc/netobank-artifacts --expires-in 3600
```

alex_se: Let's aim to send a minimal evidence bundle by Thursday AM. Maria, can you nudge them for token estimates? If they delay, send the sanitized SOC2 + architecture first.

maria_sales: On it. I'll update here when they reply. thx team :pray:
